fields.name: SQL Server Provider Package
fields.responsibility: Holds the SQL Server end of every core abstraction: the SqlClient connection settings, the provider services the core calls through, the host registration that stands the services up, and the per-SQL-type mapping surface including table-valued parameters. They belong together because each is the Microsoft.Data.SqlClient-specific completion of a seam the core leaves open, and nothing here is reachable without SqlClient.
